title: A Proclamation to Approve the Loan Agreement Between the Government of Eritrea and the African Development Fund 97/1997
text:
Proclamation No. 97/1997
A Proclamation to Approve the Loan
Agreement between the Government of
Eritrea and the African Development Fund
WHEREAS, a Loan Agreement between the Government of Eritrea and the African
Development Fund, stipulating that the African Development Fund provide to the
Government of Eritrea a loan not exceeding the equivalent of five million, five
hundred and thirty thousand Units of Account (UA 5,530,000) to assist in the
financing of the Roads component of the Recovery and Rehabilitation Programme for
Eritrea was signed in Abidjan, Coke d'Ivoire, on the 8`h of November, 1996, and
WHEREAS, the loan Agreement has been ratified by the President of the State of
Eritrea,
NOW, THEREFORE, in accordance with Article 6(4) (c) of the Definition of
Powers and Duties of the Government of Eritrea Proclamation No.37/1993, it is
hereby proclaimed as follows:
1. Short Title
This Proclamation may be cited as the “African Development Fund Loan
Agreement to assist in the Financing of the Roads Component Project of the
Recovery and Rehabilitation Programme for Eritrea Approval Proclamation
No.97/1997".
2. Definition
In this Proclamation "Loan Agreement" means the Loan Agreement signed at
Abidjan, Cote d'Ivoire, on the 8th of November, 1996, between the Government of
Eritrea and the African Development Fund.
3. Power of the Ministers of Finance and Construction
The Ministers of Finance and Construction are hereby jointly and severally
empowered to undertake all acts for the utilization of the loan not exceeding five
million, five hundred and thirty thousand Units of Account (UA, 5,530,000) in
accordance with the terms and conditions set forth in the Loan Agreement.
4. Effective Date
This Proclamation shall enter into force on the date of its publication in the
Gazette of Eritrean Laws.
Done at Asmara, this 28th of October, 1997.
Issaias Afwerki,
President of the state of Eritrea
